- Are any execs arriving earlier/later than the main block (Nov 8 evening / Nov 11 afternoon)?
- Confirm whether the leadership prefers a 9:00 PT start or 9:30 PT start on Day 1 — we have multi-timezone participants (EMEA leadership joining remotely).

Thanks — talk soon.

Susan / Mateo — quick logistics update from my side: 

- Hotel block: 24 rooms held at Harbor View (Nov 8–11). Cut-off is Oct 21. Code: REDWOOD_LYNX.
- Airport transfers: we have an MSA with Harbor Limo; estimated pickup window 60–90 minutes after flight arrival. Please send flight numbers when available.
- Local escort: assigned (Diego Ramos) — contact +1 (415) 555-0123; he has venue security clearance and parking passes. I attached Venue_Access_Instructions.pdf and the current Local_escort_roster.csv.
- AV / connectivity: primary AV vendor is AVWorks — onsite engineer Alexandria will be onsite Day 0/1. I will share engineer contact and test window 24–48 hours prior.
- Visa lanes: for participants requiring invitation letters, send full legal name, passport number, nationality, and passport expiry. Also flag any participants requiring expedited processing.

Contingency notes:
- If flights are delayed >3 hours, we will switch affected execs to the fallback virtual breakout and local staff will handle on-site rehearsal.
- If airport pickups exceed the scheduled window, Diego will coordinate rideshares and we will bill to the event code.

Action items for Lynx: please confirm headcount and provide names + passport details by Oct 14.

Best,
Kimberly
